race.comment: SIHAYA (9) ran below expectations last time at Echuca, finishing ninth and beaten 12 lengths, starting at $2.20, but that followed a fine debut run. Prepared to give her another chance here, especially from a good draw, as there is not a lot of depth to this. BACCANO (1) is back after a break of five months. At the last run before the layoff he finished 11th over 1420m at Flemington. This is much easier than that and the latest jumpout hinted a strong fresh showing is on the cards. RED TIDE (3) finished seventh at his last appearance over 1200m at Pakenham on October 30 but looks better suited here and might be ready to peak fourth-up. MYSTIC RAPTURE (8) is a 15-start maiden but does look to be edging towards a win, the latest effort being an encouraging third at Kilmore over 1462m after being prominent at the turn. Draws to get every chance. SHELTERED (4) hasn't set the world on fire at the trials, but is from one of the country's top stables and warrants respect.
